question: Let \(\{C_n\}\) be an infinite sequence of circles lying in the positive quadrant of the \(XY\)-plane, with strictly decreasing radii and satisfying the following conditions. Each \(C_n\) touches both the \(X\)-axis and the \(Y\)-axis. Further, for all \(n\ge1\), the circle \(C_n\) touches the circle \(C_{n+1}\) externally. If \(C_1\) has radius 10 cm, then show that the sum of the areas of all these circles is \(\frac{25\pi}{3\sqrt2-4}\) sq cm.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
